comment: Fusion user parameters (geometry) and mold.json settings (analysis/process/export). tier input = a mold_* user parameter S1 creates; auto = the engine's value (constant expr, or the derive rule in moldkit/core/resolve.py); profile = the printer profile (expr, overridden by the user config "printer"). Any auto or profile value is overridden for one mold by creating its mold_* user parameter. Values are research defaults; see docs/research/design-rules.md.

fusion.name: shrinkagePct
fusion.desc: Linear shrinkage % the plug is scaled up for, by 1/(1-s). 0 = model already at greenware size (no scale feature)

fusion.name: spareHeight
fusion.desc: Slip well height above the rim

fusion.name: spareStepOut
fusion.desc: Outward step at rim height = flat plaster knife ledge for trimming

fusion.name: spareFlare
fusion.desc: Outward flare of the well walls

fusion.name: plasterWall
fusion.desc: Nominal plaster wall around the cast plug

fusion.name: plasterBase
fusion.desc: Plaster thickness under the foot

fusion.name: plasterEdgeChamfer
fusion.desc: Chamfer on outer plaster edges

fusion.name: plasterOuterShape
fusion.desc: Outer plaster shape: tapered (straight tapered side around any plug, eases casing release; frustum = alias) | contoured (follows a revolved plug)

fusion.name: plasterOuterDraft
fusion.desc: Minimum draft of the tapered side (casing release); warn < 3 deg, fail < 1 deg

fusion.name: plasterOuterDraftMax
fusion.desc: Maximum draft searched for the smallest blank; = plasterOuterDraft for a fixed draft
fusion.derive: = the larger of 8 deg and plasterOuterDraft

fusion.name: plasterOuterTaper
fusion.desc: Wide end of the tapered blank: auto (smaller blank) | wideTop | wideBottom

fusion.name: layout
fusion.desc: Plaster piece layout: auto (S3 picks the best) | dropOut | sides2 | sides2Bottom | sides3Bottom | sides4Bottom

fusion.name: maxPieces
fusion.desc: Hard cap on plaster pieces

fusion.name: splitAzimuth
fusion.desc: Azimuth of the first vertical split plane, used with a fixed layout or a turned (revolved) ware; with layout auto on any other ware S3 searches the azimuth itself

fusion.name: bottomSplitMargin
fusion.desc: Margin above the highest annular slice for the bottom/side split

fusion.name: bottomSplitHeight
fusion.desc: Manual bottom split height above the foot plane; 0 = auto

fusion.name: natchRadius
fusion.desc: Sphere radius of the cap key
fusion.derive: 0.24 x plasterWall to 0.5 mm, within 3-10 mm, lowered until the socket and natchEdgeMargin fit across the wall

fusion.name: natchDepth
fusion.desc: Cap depth (about 0.58 x radius)

fusion.name: natchClearance
fusion.desc: Radial play between plaster bump and socket (independent casings); plaster to plaster, so it does not follow the printer fit (printed dome and cup errors both loosen it)

fusion.name: natchesPerSeam
fusion.desc: Keys per seam, asymmetric

fusion.name: natchEdgeMargin
fusion.desc: Min distance from a key to the cast (measured in 3D) and from its footprint to the seam edges

fusion.name: natchGender
fusion.desc: Key genders: mixed (each piece gets bumps and sockets on every interface, unique fit checked) | single (all bumps of an interface on one piece)

fusion.name: casingWall
fusion.desc: Reusable casing wall
fusion.derive: 2.4 mm rounded up to whole nozzle lines

fusion.name: casingBasePlate
fusion.desc: Base pattern plate thickness; keep it 0.8 mm over flangeThickness
fusion.derive: flangeThickness + 0.8 mm, rounded up to whole nozzle lines

fusion.name: casingRingSectors
fusion.desc: Sectors for full-ring casing backs

fusion.name: casingFreeboard
fusion.desc: Casing wall height above the plaster fill line

fusion.name: fillLineDepth
fusion.desc: Fill-line deboss depth

fusion.name: flangeThickness
fusion.desc: Flange thickness; leaves a 2.5 mm floor under the 1.5 mm ridge grooves

fusion.name: flangeWidth
fusion.desc: Flange width: the ridge zone (3 ridges: 14.6 mm) + a land at the edge; the clip beads sit over the outer grooves
fusion.derive: the ridge zone (ridgeCount, ridgeWidth, ridgeHeight, ridgeInset, seamClearance) + the 1.2 mm edge land, rounded up to whole mm

fusion.name: ridgeCount
fusion.desc: Sealing ridges per seam (same offsets on every seam, so the ridge lines turn the corners)

fusion.name: ridgeWidth
fusion.desc: Ridge top width (2 nozzle lines; 45-degree flanks below)

fusion.name: ridgeHeight
fusion.desc: Ridge height

fusion.name: ridgeInset
fusion.desc: Casing wall outer face to the first ridge

fusion.name: footGrooveInnerClear
fusion.desc: Cavity-side clearance of the first foot groove (room for the plaster's setting expansion)
fusion.derive: = seamClearance + 0.35 mm (plaster setting expansion about 0.17 mm + 0.2 mm print error)

fusion.name: seamClearance
fusion.desc: Ridge/groove clearance per flank; follows the nozzle and the fit offset. To change only the ridges (the fit offset also moves the clips), add a mold_seamClearance user parameter (this mold) or set seamClearance under printer in config.json (every mold)
fusion.derive: 0.16 mm (0.4 mm nozzle) + the fit allowance (fitOffset + 0.125 x (nozzle - 0.4 mm)); never below 0.1 mm

fusion.name: grooveBottomGap
fusion.desc: Extra groove depth so flange faces bear (the sector foot grooves print on the bed face in draft layers)
fusion.derive: the larger of 0.4 mm and 2 draft layers (layerDraft x nozzle / 0.4), rounded up to 0.05 mm

fusion.name: clipSpacingMax
fusion.desc: Max centre spacing of the short snap clips along a foot seam (force: about 5.8 N per clip)
fusion.derive: one short clip's arm force / the seam's force demand, to whole mm (never below clipWidth)

fusion.name: clipEndOffset
fusion.desc: Foot bead run and clips kept this far from a crossing flange's outer face

fusion.name: clipArm
fusion.desc: Clip arm thickness (20 mm free length)
fusion.derive: the thickest whole number of nozzle lines whose snap strain (preload + barb + 0.2 mm print error) stays within the clip filament's strain limit

fusion.name: clipWidth
fusion.desc: Short snap clip width along the seam

fusion.name: clipPreload
fusion.desc: Short clip preload per arm; spares at 0.5 and 0.9 mm are printed to compare in the leak test

fusion.name: clipRailPreload
fusion.desc: Rail clip preload per arm (vertical seams)

fusion.name: clipRailMax
fusion.desc: Longest rail clip; longer vertical seams get several stacked rails

fusion.name: lugHeight
fusion.desc: Stop lugs on the vertical flanges above the foot; the lowest rail clip rests on them

fusion.name: clipRailStyle
fusion.desc: Clips on straight vertical seams: dovetail (one tapered clip per seam slides down a dovetail ledge until tight; Meshcast style) | snap (rail clips over beads, kit v3)

fusion.name: clipDoveDepth
fusion.desc: Dovetail head depth from the flange edge (the clip walls cover it)

fusion.name: clipDoveAngle
fusion.desc: Dovetail lean of the head face: the head is thicker at the flange edge, so the clip cannot be pulled off sideways

fusion.name: clipDoveTaper
fusion.desc: Taper of the dovetail ledge and clip, per face: 1 mm thicker per this many mm down the seam (self-locking)

fusion.name: clipDoveWall
fusion.desc: Dovetail clip side wall thickness

fusion.name: clipDoveSpine
fusion.desc: Dovetail clip spine thickness; it bears on the ledge edge and its bending is the clip's spring

fusion.name: clipDoveReuse
fusion.desc: Clip reuse: a straight seam may take a standard dovetail clip up to this much shorter than it allows, so equal clips serve several seams (fewer sizes to print)

fusion.name: clipRoundTaper
fusion.desc: Taper of the round clips (curved foot seams), per face: 1 mm thicker per this many mm along the arc; steeper than the straight clips so more stations fit (seat gap 4 mm)

fusion.name: clipRoundMax
fusion.desc: Longest round clip considered; the mold's one round clip length (16 mm up to this) is the one that clamps the most arc over all foot seams

fusion.name: clipDoveInterference
fusion.desc: Squeeze per head face when the dovetail clip is seated (about 8 mm of travel after it first grips)

fusion.name: bedX
fusion.desc: Printer bed X

fusion.name: bedY
fusion.desc: Printer bed Y

fusion.name: bedZ
fusion.desc: Printer height

fusion.name: bedMargin
fusion.desc: Safety margin inside the bed limits

fusion.name: nozzle
fusion.desc: Nozzle diameter (the Make mold dialog asks for it): walls and ridges snap to whole lines, layer heights scale with it, printed clearances open 0.125 mm per mm over 0.4

fusion.name: fitOffset
fusion.desc: Per-side fit correction from your tolerance test: + loosens every printed fit (ridge grooves, clip openings and barbs), - tightens; 0 for a calibrated printer

fusion.name: printTolerance
fusion.desc: Dimensional accuracy of your printer, +- per side: dovetail clip clearances are 2x this, and the clip seats this much x 2 x the taper above its stop lug

clipFilament.desc: Clip filament stiffness: elastic modulus low / mid / high (MPa) and the bending strain (%) a clip arm takes without whitening
